raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "5.0.0"
  build_number: 0

  # dependencies
  lal_version: 8.0.0
  lalburst_version: 3.0.0
  lalframe_version: 3.1.0
  lalinspiral_version: 5.1.0
  lalmetaio_version: 4.1.0
  lalsimulation_version: 7.0.0

  # LAL requires downstream packages to be built with the same version of SWIG,
  # so we need to pin it here
  swig_version: 4.4.1

  # help2man needs to run the executables, which isn't possible when
  # cross-compiling
  manpages: ${{ build_platform == target_platform }}

recipe:
  name: lalinference-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/lalsuite/lalinference-${{ version }}.tar.xz
    sha256: 6690bf58d88e451e2e73ade9e82f596f9add4d11b83b2857655a8d79561759a9

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - win

outputs:

  # -- Staging -----------------------

  - staging:
      name: lalinference-c-build
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - python >=3.6
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
      host:
        - gsl
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - liblalburst >=${{ lalburst_version }}
        - liblalframe >=${{ lalframe_version }}
        - liblalinspiral >=${{ lalinspiral_version }}
        - liblalmetaio >=${{ lalmetaio_version }}
        - liblalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
          else: llvm-openmp

  # -- Packages ----------------------

  - package:
      name: lalinference-data
    inherit:
      from: lalinference-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - etc/conda/activate.d/activate-lalinference-data.*
        - etc/conda/deactivate.d/deactivate-lalinference-data.*
        - share/lalinference/
    requirements:
      run_constraints:
        - liblalinference >=3.0.3
    tests:
      - script:
          - test -f "${LALINFERENCE_DATADIR}/fiducialBNS.xml"
          - test -f "${LALINFERENCE_DATADIR}/lalinference_pipe_example.ini"
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Inference Library data files
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Inference Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the data files needed to run various applications
        and routines that use the LAL Inference library.

  - package:
      name: liblalinference
    inherit: lalinference-c-build
    build:
      files:
        - include/lal/
        - lib/liblalinference*
        - lib/pkgconfig/lalinference*.pc
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("lalinference-data", exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinference", upper_bound="x") }}
      run_constraints:
        - lalinference >=2.0.6
        - python-lalinference >=2.0.6
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - lalinference
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          # check activate variables
          - test "${LALINFERENCE_DATADIR}" = "${PREFIX}/share/lalinference"
          # check pkg-config
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${PKG_VERSION}" lalinference
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Inference Library shared object libraries
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Inference Library for gravitational wave data
        analysis.  This package contains the shared object libraries
        needed to run applications that use the LAL Inference library.

  - package:
      name: python-lalinference
    inherit:
      from: lalinference-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/
      script: build-python
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinference", exact=True) }}
        - numpy
        - python
      run:
        - astropy-base >=1.1.1
        - healpy >=1.17.3
        - h5py
        - igwn-ligolw >=2.1.0
        - igwn-segments
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinference", exact=True) }}
        - lscsoft-glue >=1.54.1
        - matplotlib-base >=1.2.0
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - python-lalburst >=${{ lalburst_version }}
        - python-lalinspiral >=${{ lalinspiral_version }}
        - python-lalmetaio >=${{ lalmetaio_version }}
        - python-lalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
        - scipy >=0.9.0
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalinference
            - lalinference.bayespputils
            - lalinference.imrtgr
            - lalinference.imrtgr.imrtgrutils
            - lalinference.imrtgr.nrutils
            - lalinference.imrtgr.pneqns
            - lalinference.lalinference_pipe_utils
            - lalinference.nest2pos
            - lalinference.plot
            - lalinference.tiger
            - lalinference.tiger.make_injtimes
            - lalinference.tiger.omegascans_dag
            - lalinference.tiger.postproc
            - lalinference.wrapper
          pip_check: false
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pytest >=4.0
        files:
          source:
            - test/python/
        script:
          - python -m pytest -ra -v test/python
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Inference Library Python libraries
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Inference Library for gravitational wave data
        analysis.  This package contains the Python bindings of
        the LALInference C libraries and additional Python modules.

        Note: this package only provides the importable Python libraries.
        All command-line interfaces, scripts, and executables are
        part of the `lalinference` package.

  - package:
      name: lalinference
    inherit:
      from: lalinference-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      # prioritise nompi via build number
      # (build_number in the string below already resolves to this value)
      number: ${{ build_number + 100 if mpi == "nompi" else build_number }}
      string: ${{ "nompi" if mpi == "nompi" else "mpi_" ~ mpi }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      files:
        - bin/
        - etc/lalinference-user-env.*
        - share/man/
      script: build-bin
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - if: manpages
          then: help2man >=1.37
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - rsync
        - sed
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
            - if: mpi == "openmpi"
              then: ${{ mpi }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinference", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalinference", exact=True) }}
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - if: mpi != "nompi"
          then:
            - if: linux
              then: libgomp
              else: llvm-openmp
            - gsl
            - liblalmetaio >=${{ lalmetaio_version }}
            - ${{ mpi }}
        # needed by ./configure
        - numpy
        - python
        # help2man runs the Python scripts, which need their runtime dependencies
        - if: manpages
          then:
            - astropy-base >=1.1.1
            # for lalinference_cpnest
            - cpnest
            - h5py
            - igwn-ligolw >=2.1.0
            - ligo-gracedb
            - lscsoft-glue >=1.54.1
            - matplotlib-base >=1.2.0
            - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
            - python-lalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
            - scipy >=0.9.0
            - six
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalinference", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalinference", exact=True) }}
        - astropy-base >=1.1.1
        - h5py
        - igwn-ligolw >=2.1.0
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - ligo-gracedb
        - lscsoft-glue >=1.54.1
        - matplotlib-base >=1.2.0
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - python-lalsimulation >=${{ lalsimulation_version }}
        - scipy >=0.9.0
        - six
        - if: mpi != "nompi"
          then:
            - gsl
            - liblalmetaio >=${{ lalmetaio_version }}
            - ${{ mpi }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalinference
          pip_check: false
      - requirements:
          run:
            - cpnest
            - openssh
        script:
          # assert that the manuals don't just contain errors
          - if: manpages
            then:
              - grep -q ModuleNotFoundError ${PREFIX}/share/man/man1/{cbcBayes,imrtgr_,lalinference_}*.1 && exit 1
              - cat "${PREFIX}/share/man/man1/lalinference_pipe.1" | head -n 20
          # data files
          - test -f "${LALINFERENCE_DATADIR}/lalinference_pipe_example.ini"
          # C executables
          - lalinference_bench --psdlength 1000 --psdstart 1 --seglen 8 --srate 4096 --trigtime 0 --ifo H1 --H1-channel LALSimAdLIGO --H1-cache LALSimAdLIGO --dataseed 1324 --Niter 10 --fix-chirpmass 1.21
          - lalinference_datadump --help
          - lalinference_injectedlike --help
          - if: mpi != "nompi"
            then:
              - lalinference_kombine --help
              - lalinference_mcmc --help
          - lalinference_nest --help
          - lalinference_version --verbose
          # the user environment script rewrites PATH, so check that it still works
          - bash -c '. "${PREFIX}/etc/lalinference-user-env.sh" && lalinference_version'
          # python scripts
          - cbcBayesBurstPPAnalysis --help
          - cbcBayesBurstPostProc --help
          - cbcBayesCombinePTMCMCh5s --help
          - cbcBayesCombinePosteriors --help
          - cbcBayesCompPos --help
          - cbcBayesDIEvidence --help
          - cbcBayesGraceDBinfo --help
          - cbcBayesMCMC2pos --help
          - cbcBayesPPAnalysis --help
          - cbcBayesPlotSpinDisk --help
          - cbcBayesPosToSimBurst --help
          - cbcBayesPosToSimInspiral --help
          - cbcBayesPostProc --help
          - cbcBayesThermoInt --help
          - imrtgr_imr_consistency_test --help
          - lalinference_burst_pp_pipe --help
          - lalinference_coherence_test --help
          - lalinference_compute_roq_weights --help
          - lalinference_cpnest --help
          - lalinference_merge_posteriors --help
          - lalinference_multi_pipe --help
          - lalinference_nest2pos --help
          - lalinference_pipe --help
          - lalinference_pp_pipe --help
          - lalinference_review_test --help
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Inference Library
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Inference Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the runtime tools.
